description: This file contains a shell script for testing Git behavior, specifically testing combined diff options (--cc, -p), stat, and color-moved detection. It sets up a git repository with commits and merges, runs git commands with specific options, and verifies the output against expected results.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: git merge
methods.description: Merges two or more development histories together.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Gets various kinds of commit and object identifiers.

methods.name: git log
methods.description: Shows commit logs with various formatting options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
